lines.text: Banqu Inte nationale du Bénin S.A.

k1067385914.notes: Rooftop bank fascia at Dantokpa, Cotonou, far away and at an angle, seen from a motorbike lane. On the target (right) sign the letters 'e' of 'Banque' and 'r' of 'Internationale' are physically missing, so the text is transcribed as it stands. The faded word before DANTOKPA (apparently 'AGENCE') is too unclear to transcribe. A second fascia on the left repeats '...nationale du Bénin S.A. / ...CE DANTOKPA' and is cut by the frame. The orange cosmetics billboard ahead is a distractor.

k1067431522.reason: only a building sign cut off by the frame ('...NCIEL'); nothing else legible

k1067440606.notes: Hand-lettered white panel with a red arrow pointing left, Cotonou, warning drivers to slow down for the CNHU-HKM hospital 1000 m ahead. HOPITAL has no circumflex; 'à' has a grave accent; 'CNHU-' is hyphenated across the line break. The curved white ministry signboard above the gate (Direction générale ... des médias) is too small and angled to read and is a distractor. Alternative query: 'Hôpital CNHU'.

c87957759.notes: Large white panel on a compound wall in Cotonou. The smaller 'Bureau du SHERPA' board above it (partly hidden by a branch) is a distractor and not transcribed.
